idea: a cozy autumn pumpkin farm with pumpkin patches, a warm barn, an apple orchard, friendly farm animals, golden leaves, and clear open paths

bible.title: Pumpkin Farm Mystery

setting.name: Maple Patch Farm
setting.description: A cozy autumn pumpkin farm with a warm barn, an apple orchard, friendly farm animals, golden leaves, and clear open paths.

player.description: A small baby pig with a round pink face, tiny trotters, and bright curious eyes

bible.narratorIntro: Piglet the baby pig got a little turned around on Maple Patch Farm. The paths are clear, the leaves are golden, and three friendly neighbors are ready to help Piglet find Mama Pig.

buildings.name: Warm Barn
buildings.exteriorDescription: A big red barn with a glowing doorway, a tidy hay porch, and pumpkins stacked by the steps.
buildings.interiorDescription: Inside is a cozy barn room with hay bales, a feed shelf, and warm lantern light.

buildings.name: Apple Orchard Shed
buildings.exteriorDescription: A small wooden shed beside neat rows of apple trees, with a basket rack and a painted apple sign.
buildings.interiorDescription: Inside is a little orchard stop with apple crates, a stamp table, and a sweet cider smell.

buildings.name: Pumpkin Patch Stand
buildings.exteriorDescription: A cheerful open stand at the edge of the pumpkin patch, with round orange pumpkins piled high.
buildings.interiorDescription: Inside is a tiny market nook with a pumpkin counter, ribbon tags, and a chalkboard price sign.

buildings.name: Hayloft Stack
buildings.exteriorDescription: A tall stack of golden hay bales with a rope ladder and a sleepy crow perch on top.

buildings.name: Tool Shed
buildings.exteriorDescription: A tiny blue shed with rakes, trowels, and a row of boots resting outside.

buildings.name: Corn Crate Corner
buildings.exteriorDescription: A shaded corner with a big corn crate, a wheelbarrow, and a bundle of dried stalks.

npcs.name: Mabel
npcs.appearance: A gentle brown cow with a cream snout, a blue collar, and tidy white spots.
npcs.personality: Calm, kind, and a little sleepy in a cozy way.

lines.hint: I am sure Mama did not stop at Warm Barn.
lines.idle: Moo... the hay smells nice today.

conversation.speechStyle: Slow and soft, with gentle moos.
smallTalkFacts: The barn lights glow at dusk.
She likes to chew hay after work.
She hears the pumpkin carts roll by all day.
conversation.clueLeadIn: Moo, I noticed where Mama waddled last.

npcs.name: Ollie
npcs.appearance: A round owl with speckled feathers, a tiny vest, and big shiny eyes.

lines.hint: I am sure Mama did not stop at Pumpkin Patch Stand.
lines.idle: Hoo... I know every crunchy leaf here.

conversation.speechStyle: Soft and thoughtful, with little hoots.
smallTalkFacts: The orchard rows are neat and easy to walk through.
Apples fall into baskets when they are ripe.
He watches the paths from a low branch at sunset.
conversation.clueLeadIn: Hoo, I spotted her near a place with fruit trees.

npcs.name: Dotty
npcs.appearance: A bright yellow duck with a red ribbon and a shiny orange beak.

lines.hint: I am sure Mama did not stop at Hayloft Stack.
lines.idle: Quack! The pumpkins are extra round today.

conversation.speechStyle: Fast and peppy, with happy quacks.
smallTalkFacts: The stand is full of round orange pumpkins.
Dotty likes to tap signs with her beak.
Visitors can walk straight to the stand on the open path.

visualDirection.architecture: A tidy autumn farm with a central dirt path, a red barn to one side, an apple orchard lane to the other, and pumpkin patches and animal pens arranged around the path.
visualDirection.lighting: Bright clear daytime light with a soft golden autumn glow.
visualDirection.atmosphere: Cozy, friendly, and gently funny, with crisp fall charm and lots of open space for little feet.
visualDirection.walkableSurface: Packed dirt paths, wooden boardwalk edges, and neat straw mats near doorways.
visualDirection.imageStyle: Storybook children's illustration with soft textures and simple shapes.
